قُيّدت طلبات تحديث المدارات بمجموعات عام: Orbit updates are restricted to known public groups, without sending search text, coordinates or report content. Uploads and unapproved background channels are blocked in the network interfaces used by the app, including calculation workers.

يمكن حفظ المتابعة والمدخلات والتقارير في: Watchlists, inputs and reports can be saved in this browser so you can continue later. Turning off “Save my work on this device” clears saved work and keeps new work only for this session; it is lost when the page reloads.
زر مسح بيانات مدار يزيل العمل المخزّن دا: Clear Madar data removes work stored in this browser and reloads the page. It does not delete downloaded or shared files, or copies in another browser. Interface and protection preferences, such as language and allowing updates, remain.
البيانات المحفوظة ليست مشفّرة بواسطة مدا: Data saved by Madar is not encrypted by the app, and there is no app PIN or biometric lock. Anyone with access to the browser session may be able to view it; use your device lock and avoid saving sensitive information on a shared device.

هذه الضوابط تقلّل مخاطر خروج البيانات عب: These controls reduce the risk of data leaving through Madar features. They do not provide absolute protection from a compromised device, malicious browser extensions or someone else accessing the device.
